result: The registered Codex call returned one content-addressed README draft, but its JSON event stream and targeted local logs contained no native HookStarted, HookCompleted, or independently identifiable Harness authority-projection evidence. The registration made that evidence mandatory and required an immediate stop on an evidence gap, so the Claude call did not run and this attempt cannot promote O1-O5.

chronology.grant: one temporary Codex SessionStart Hook, one Codex gpt-5.6-sol call, and one Claude Code claude-opus-4-8 call with a USD 2.00 Claude ceiling

chronology.claim: The absence proves an evidence-floor failure, not that the command definitely did not execute.

falsifiersTriggered: mandatory native Hook event evidence was missing
the Harness authority projection could not be independently identified
continuing to the Claude call would have violated the registered stop rule

causalFinding.fact: Codex 0.147.0 returned the requested copy under a read-only ephemeral invocation, but the chosen exec evidence surface did not expose the registration's required native Hook chronology or an independently identifiable projection marker.
causalFinding.inference: Coupling a public-copy delivery to continuity-adapter behavior and O5 evidence added a noncausal mandatory floor that could stop the user-valued result before the independent alternative ran.
causalFinding.correction: Exit this attempt from the active graph, preserve it as counterevidence, and pre-register a smallest-sufficient recovery route that delivers the same README demand through the still-authorized Claude call without any Hook, plugin, adapter, or portability claim.

humanAuthority.unusedGrantedOperation: one Claude Code claude-opus-4-8 call with a USD 2.00 ceiling remains unused for the same README demand

claimLimit: This is a stopped task attempt and counterevidence against coupling user-valued delivery to noncausal adapter evidence. It proves neither accepted README value, live Hook behavior, O1-O5, methodology value, cross-host portability, release, production readiness, nor v0.2 completion.
